Name: Kimberly's Witch Bathroom for PIF
Author: Iceprincess98
Description:
This mod is a PIF conversion of the bathroom in ChangHai6979's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1375]Kimberly's Witch.Kitchen.Bed.Bathroom.Crib[/url].
Thank you to ChangHai6979 for allowing their mod to be converted!
The beds and crib of the original mod can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28954]here[/url], the kitchen is its own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28969]seperate mod[/url] that is highly configurable (thanks to the wonderful glymr).


To acces the room you need to place a door, either from PIF or a decorative door from vanilla. The room itself has a bath that replenishes your health and energy, a changing screen to enter the bath and depending on the file some furniture.
If you want to fully decorate the room yourself, you can! There is an optional file with only the bath and changing screen. 



I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25684]farmerbeans' bathroom furniture[/url] to decorate the rooms in the images (available in AT and CP).
Definitely check it out if you like their work.
